verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
You give joy unspeakable
And life forevermore
And love unsearchable
And mercies unending

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Your mercies unending
New every morning

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
You overwhelm my soul
With lovingkindness

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
It's who You are
It's what You love to do
It's what You do, Lord
I'm leaning to You

verse.name: v1d
verse.lines:
I was an orphan, You gave a family
I was an enemy and You made Your friend
Hallelujah!

verse.name: v1e
verse.lines:
Your mercies unending
Your mercies unending
New every morning
New every morning
